name: End Card

chatHistory.content:
Create a Remotion composition featuring a pricing card positioned in the lower third of the frame.

LAYOUT:
- Full canvas, transparent or neutral background
- Card anchored in the lower third of the screen, horizontally centered
- Card width is compact (~340px), not full-width — it reads as a small floating box, not a hero element
- Leave clear breathing room around the card (top, sides, and bottom)

CARD STRUCTURE (vertical stack inside the card):

Container: white background, light gray border (1px), rounded corners, ~32px padding.

1. Plan name: "Free" — large heading, bold, dark text
2. Price: "$0" — extra large display heading, bold, dark text, tight spacing below the plan name
3. Tagline: "$5 to spend in Apify Store or on your own Actors" — medium gray body text, wraps to two lines, moderate spacing above

4. Feature list (vertical stack, ~12px row gap, icon + label aligned horizontally):
   - Blue checkmark + "$0.2 per compute unit"
   - Blue checkmark + "Community support"
   - Gray X + "No Apify Store discount"

5. CTA button: "Start for free" — near full card width, white background, light gray border, rounded corners, bold dark label, ~16px vertical padding, larger top spacing (~24px)

6. Footer: "No credit card required." — small gray text below the button, modest top margin

SPACING RULE: looser gaps between groups (price → tagline → features → button), tighter within groups (icon + label, button + footer).
